summary: Iter145 verification: Backend #49 Security Insights pytest 5/5 PASS. Frontend #49 Security Insights end-to-end PASS (Owner sees all 7 testid blocks: security-insights, security-summary with 4 KPI cards, security-hourly-chart, security-top-ips, security-top-users, security-recent-failures, security-window-select, security-refresh-btn). #50 FAQ page PASS (15 faq-items, 6 sections, search filter + pricing pill narrows to 4, toggle/answer works, contact CTA + footer-faq-link present). #52 Multi-step wizard PASS (3 step-pills, step1 next disabled when empty / enabled when filled, step2 next disabled with weak password / enabled with strong, step3 has 4 plan-card-* options, back nav returns to step2, step-pill-1 jumps to step1). #51 Notifications grouping: implementation verified in code (testids grouping-toggle, notification-group-{type}, notification-group-toggle-{type}, notification-group-expanded-{type}, mark-all-read-btn all present in NotificationCenter.js) — could NOT visually verify because /app/notifications renders empty 'لا توجد إشعارات بعد' for resident `test` despite DB containing 12 notifications (7 bulk_offer + 5 gift). Invoices responsive-card-table: code verified — invoices-table has class='responsive-card-table' + each td has data-label (FinancialManagement.js line 255+); CSS rules in index.css line 376+ properly convert to card layout on mobile; could NOT visually verify because testcompany2 has 0 invoices.

integration_issues.issue: Resident `test` has 12 notifications in DB but /app/notifications renders empty state. This blocks visual verification of #51 grouping but the React component code itself is correct.

action_items: Investigate why GET /api/notifications returns 0 for resident `test` even though 12 docs exist for user_id d6012878-... (likely a compound_id/persona filter). Once notifications surface in the UI the #51 grouping can be visually validated.

Optional: minor naming discrepancies between review-request testids and code: 'wizard-step-pill-{n}' is actually 'step-pill-{n}'; 'wizard-plan-{key}' is 'plan-card-{key}'; 'mark-all-read' is 'mark-all-read-btn'. Functionality is identical; consider aligning request docs with implementation.
critical_code_review_comments: FinancialManagement is now reachable at /app/financial-old route (not /app/financial). If product wants 'Invoices' visible to residents on mobile, route exposure may need rework.

CompanyRegistrationWizard step3 submit button is wired to disabled = (loading || !isStep3Valid) which works, but in test the submit briefly read disabled=false BEFORE plan pick on one run; visually the screenshot shows the button as gray (cursor-not-allowed). Likely a stale-DOM read race; functional behavior is correct.
